comment: Dr. Allred's Working FYS is a great class! If you put in the work, you will get an A. He is a solid professor who cares about his students. Class is largely discussion-based and Dr. Allred is extremely knowledgeable in the subject matter, making it easy to grasp concepts. I highly recommend taking this FYS.

Dr. Allred's working FYS was great! There are 4 small (2-4 page) papers and a 10 page final paper, but none of them are too hard. Dr. Allred is a fair grader and makes the class interesting. There is quite a bit of reading but its manageable. If you are willing to put in some work, I would highly recommend his FYS!

There are a lot of small papers, but they aren't hard and are graded fairly easy. There are readings for every class that you need to at least skim for the discussions and participation is a large part of your grade. I think the subject is super interesting, but not the easiest fys. It requires work so if you're willing to put in some work take it!

Dr. Allred isn't a great professor; clearly knowledgable and passionate but not an amazing professor. Readings are interesting and class discussions are fun. Very unclear grading criteria and you do have to work moderately hard to get an A. Okay class -- not too great, not too bad
Dr. Allred is a good professor and no doubt that he knows what he's talking about. Passionate guy which makes it interesting. Put a little effort and shouldn't be too hard to get an A.

Took his Working FYS. Lots of small papers plus final ten page research paper and presentation. Fantastic person and teacher. Small amount of reading each class you can skim. Interesting topic and he makes it even more interesting. Pretty easy to get an A. Awesome guy! Definitely recommend for FYS!
